text:
Your own home screen and phone remote for the TV. 
 Scenes with a glass clock, your apps in your order, Keep watching across apps,
 and a phone remote that finds a show and starts it. No ads on the home screen. Open source.
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 Set it up 
  ·  Which TVs 
  ·  Docs 
  ·  What's new 
 

 Get started

1. With your AI agent, the easiest way. Open this folder in Claude Code (or any coding agent)
 and say "set this up on my TV". It reads AGENTS.md, finds your TV, asks which option
 you want and a few questions (who watches, the look, your apps), reads the plan back, and changes
 nothing on the TV until you say yes.
2. From your phone or a computer: couchtv.sites.underseage.studio,
 with the free Setup app on a Mac or Windows computer. It also checks whether your TV will work.
3. By hand: docs/SETUP.md has every step, from developer mode to the TV home,
 and how to undo it.

 Pick the way for your TV before you start. Not every way does the whole job on every TV:

 Way What you need Google TV Android TV Fire TV Samsung or LG 
 --- --- --- --- --- --- 
 AI agent (AGENTS.md) A computer on the TV's Wi-Fi with Claude Code or another coding agent Yes, Home button included Yes Yes, Home button included (Amazon's home flashes up first). The full phone remote keeps a computer on at home Yes, as an app that a computer at home that stays on opens. Their own Home button still opens their own menu 
 From your phone (website) The TV remote and a phone on the same Wi-Fi. No computer Only part: the app and the phone remote, but Google keeps the Home button. AI or the Setup app adds the Home button once, even afterwards Yes. On Android TV 10 and newer the app asks Android to make it the home Only part: Home needs three one off grants from a computer, and on current Fire OS the phone remote can't press keys or type No 
 Setup app (website) A Mac or Windows computer on the same Wi-Fi, once Yes, Home button included Yes, Android TV 7.1 and newer Yes on Fire OS 6, 7 and 8 (Amazon's home flashes up first) No 
 By hand (docs/SETUP.md) A Mac or Linux computer with Python 3.11 or newer Yes Yes on-tv/README.md, Fire TV docs/SAMSUNG.md, docs/LG.md, with a computer at home that stays on 

Other TVs: Will it work on my TV?

 [!NOTE]
 Set couch-tv up with 0.10 or older on a Google TV? 0.11 and newer leave the Google home and setup
 apps switched on. Read If your TV loops after a restart
 before you next restart your TV.

 

 Updates

The newest release is 0.12 (9 November 2026), on the Releases page. These are on main, in the next release:

- 14 November: custom cards with a web link open in the TV's browser on Android TV, LG and Samsung, thanks ekagra-codes ( 207)
- 14 November: choose where the home starts: profiles (as before), Keep watching or apps, thanks nidhalmouldi and ekagra-codes ( 211)

- 15 November: the clock follows the TV's 12 or 24 hour setting, and Keep watching stays in view while you remove a show, thanks devmaliakbar and Hiren-Patel1 ( 221, 218)
- 14 November: Restart home in Home settings, About, thanks janooh37-hue ( 217)
- 14 November: two more real LGs (a NANO80TNA app only, a 28TQ515S with the bridge in Docker on a Synology), and --apps tv pairs by itself, thanks Anshul7171 and adri07 ( 219, 220)
- 14 November: on a VIZIO, couch-tv's home in the TV's own webview, Beta, tried on one set, thanks lukionsp ( 206)
- 14 November: input tiles for each TV, and a picture on an input tile, thanks BireshwarChakravarty ( 205)
- 14 November: an LG goes back to couch-tv in about half a second, and input tiles switch straight to HDMI, thanks BireshwarChakravarty ( 204)
- 14 November: remove a card from Keep watching on the phone remote, and it returns when you play the show again, thanks poinch ( 176)
- 14 November: your own cards on the home from a small JSON file, display only, thanks geissmannz on Instagram for the idea (custom cards)
- 14 November: the bridge's messages in Polish, and the assistant answers in the home's language, thanks Azumi0 ( 196)
- 14 November: a TV settings quick button, and Settings opens on its own screen, thanks syedhabibtirmizi ( 190)
- 14 November: the TV home installs over paired Wireless debugging, tested on an Epson LS300, thanks mazzanfar ( 194)
- 14 November: the Look button and Home settings changes show at once on the TV home, thanks clembgrn and syedhabibtirmizi ( 185)
- 14 November: the phone remote is complete in Brazilian Portuguese, thanks scursel ( 195)
- 14 November: Czech is complete on the TV home and the phone remote speaks Czech, thanks slezaCZ ( 180)
- 14 November: home.hi res: "always" loads the sharper 4K scenes on a 4K TV that draws its interface at 1080, thanks Hiren-Patel1 ( 191)
- 14 November: an app banner that is not 16:9 keeps its proportions instead of being squeezed, thanks niravsaxena30 ( 181)
- 13 November: the TV home speaks Czech, thanks slezaCZ ( 178)
- 13 November: Bell Streamer's Fibe TV home is replaced by couch-tv (Beta, untested), thanks Sparkybabcia ( 168)
- 13 November: Privacy clean (Beta): PRIVACY=1 switches off known tracking, ad and ACR apps, reversibly (docs/PRIVACY.md, details)
- 13 November: the home comes back to the tile you left after Settings, thanks IshMehta ( 166)
- 13 November: on Fire OS 7 Couch TV comes back without the 5 second wait, thanks atul016 ( 162)
- 13 November: the Next song button skips the track again on a Mi Box, thanks NathanGlasby ( 158)
- 14 November: Brazilian Portuguese on the TV home and the phone remote, thanks scursel ( 193)
- 14 November: Polish on the TV home and the phone remote, thanks Azumi0 ( 184)
- 13 November: the TV home speaks Hebrew, right to left, thanks YuvalHir ( 153)

Every change, with credits: docs/UPDATES.md.

 Three ways to run it

- A. TV home only. The new home screen, and you use your normal TV remote. No computer has to
 stay on. Set up with docs/SETUP.md, steps 1, 2 and 6.
